company.name: Memfault
company.shortDescription: Memfault is an IoT reliability platform giving developers a more scalable & sustainable process to transform the way they build & operate.
company.description:
Memfault provides solutions for firmware delivery, monitoring, and diagnostics to consumer electronics businesses. The company takes care of software updates and diagnostics, so that the user can focus on what makes its products unique. Memfault’s SDK works with existing hardware. Monitor and deploy a firmware to low level devices via Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, USB, or proprietary protocol.

Memfault is based in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that monitors and collects diagnostic data from embedded IoT devices to detect faults and performance issues remotely.
productsAndServices.name: Embedded Observability Platform

productsAndServices.description: A system to manage, deploy, and monitor firmware updates remotely on embedded and Android devices with staged rollouts and rollback controls.
productsAndServices.name: Over-the-Air (OTA) Update Management

productsAndServices.description: A platform tailored for AOSP developers to monitor, debug, and update Android-based embedded devices with crash capture and OTA capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: Memfault for Android

productsAndServices.description: Automated collection of coredumps, crash logs, reboot reasons, and performance metrics from devices to facilitate remote debugging and issue resolution.
productsAndServices.name: Device Diagnostics and Crash Data Collection

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based system that provides real-time and historical visibility into the health, performance, and reliability of device fleets.
productsAndServices.name: Fleet Monitoring and Analytics
